text:
Maria Lopez: Quick preflight for Thu webinar (Inference at Scale) — 9am PT. Need final owners for reg page, Zoom config, recording split, and post-event flows. Can we confirm?
Alex Chen: I can own the reg page. Planning an A/B on CTA (Save spot vs Join live). Also propose we collect company size bucket.
Maria Lopez: Yes to company size. Keep form short: name / email / company / role / size bucket. Add GDPR consent checkbox for EU registrants.
Taylor Ng: Zoom host notes — enable cloud recording, record separate audio track, captions (live auto-caption + SRT). Recommend passcode off, use waiting room + only authenticated users off (easier for external). Any objections?
Samir Patel: For the SRT+clip pipeline: we'll push raw cloud recording + SRT to S3, then kick off a Lambda to run speech->chapter markers (whisper) and generate clips. Need two clip owners to tag highlight timestamps.
Jade Ortiz: I'll own HubSpot mapping and email cadence. Will create properties: webinar_attended, webinar_reg_source, webinar_product_interest. Tag all registrants with campaign=webinar-2026-03-26.
Alex Chen: About gating the replay — gate for non-registrants only? We prefer registrants get immediate access, public replay after 48h.
Maria Lopez: Agreed — registrants immediate. Public gate at 48h. Also ensure UTM params are on all CTA links.
Taylor Ng: Confirmed Zoom account has cloud recording + SRT licenses. Doing dry run Wed 3pm PT. Also will enable 'record active speaker, gallery' so we get both tracks.
Samir Patel: Ops note: include a short `obs` marker flow if presenters can press a hotkey to create chapter markers. Fallback: we'll detect long pauses for chapter split.
Maria Lopez: @Taylor can you add host + alternative co-hosts to the event? We can't have single point of failure.
Taylor Ng: Done — co-hosts: Alex Chen + Samir Patel. Also set recording retention 30 days in Zoom.
ops-bot: calendar created: Webinar - Inference at Scale — Thu 2026-03-26 09:00 PT. Recording enabled.
Jade Ortiz: Post-event email plan (owner: Jade): 1) Immediate: Thanks + replay link for registrants (auto). 2) 24h: Highlights clip(s) + TL;DR. 3) 72h: Benchmark narrative + link to benchmark blog/asset. 4) 1 week: CTA to book a demo. I'll add conditional branches for Dedicated vs Hosted customers.
Alex Chen: Draft reg page: https://staging.example.com/webinar-inference — copy + CTAs in place. Need creative assets (hero image, speaker headshots) by EOD Wed.
Samir Patel: Recording pipeline checklist: SRT + MP4 -> s3://redwood-webinars/raw/<event>/ -> lambda -> s3://redwood-webinars/processed/<event>/. Quick command for review: `aws s3 cp s3://redwood-webinars/processed/1767/highlight.mp4 ./`
Maria Lopez: Also add transcript QC step: human spot-check one random 5-min chunk before publishing.
Jade Ortiz: HubSpot mapping done. Will build workflow that sets lifecycle stage to MQL if attendee AND uses product_interest=dedicated.
Alex Chen: UTM plan: utm_source=org-email, utm_medium=webinar, utm_campaign=inference-mar26. Will append to replay/public links.
Taylor Ng: Dry run confirmed Wed 3pm PT — please be available for 15m. I'll simulate recording and SRT export.
Maria Lopez: Last ask — legal: any special phrasing for EU consent? Jade, can you loop legal?
Jade Ortiz: On it. Will CC legal and add specific GDPR checkbox text: `Yes, I consent to Redwood Inference contacting me about this webinar and related content.`
Samir Patel: After publish, I'll open GH issue for clip extraction with timestamps and speaker labels. If we can capture speaker labels in SRT that's ideal.
Maria Lopez: Great — checklist now: reg page owner (Alex), Zoom host (Taylor), recording pipeline (Samir), HS mapping & emails (Jade). Everyone good? :thumbsup:
Alex Chen: Good from copy side.
Taylor Ng: Good on infra side.
Jade Ortiz: Good — I'll post workflows and email templates by Wed EOD.
Samir Patel: Good — will test S3 pipeline during dry run.
Maria Lopez: Thanks team — I'll close this thread once Wed dry run passes.
